newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Hyundai Mipo awaits nod on Vietnam deal.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Mipo awaits nod on Vietnam deal.

text.p: Vietnam's Planning and Investment Minister has passed plans for a $95.39 million shipyard project involving Hyundai Mipo Dockyard Co to the prime minister for approval, the state-controlled Vietnam Economic Times said.
Approval from the prime minister is usually a formality for foreign investors seeking a licence.

The proposed project in the southern province of Khanh Hoa would be a joint venture between four companies belonging to the South Korean company and the Vietnam Shipbuilding Industry Corp (VINASHIN). The Vietnamese partner's share would be 30 percent.
Vietnam Economic Times said the shipyard would repair 100 ships and build five new each year and also manufacture equipment for oil exploration.
Hyundai Mipo said in March that it expected the shipyard to start operations in January 1998.
